scope: Mixed synthetic protocol study: fresh stochastic holdout plus deterministic development calibration; not a representative external corpus
license: MIT (SymQ-generated circuits; no third-party circuit copies)
old_blind_corpus_status: explored historical development evidence; never a new holdout

measurement_contracts.public_api_end_to_end: Actual installed verification API on existing Circuit IR; internal conversion/setup/decision/witness replay included. Symbolic service uses installed make_algebra/simulate/to_anf. Input IR generation, independent validation, startup and IPC excluded and reported separately; internal phase attribution unavailable (null).
measurement_contracts.task_service_end_to_end: Declared staged adapter service including input IR construction, conversion, setup, simulation/decision, comparison, required witness and replay, and requested ANF export. Independent validation and worker startup excluded.
measurement_contracts.precompiled_service: Same staged adapter service minus the measured tool-conversion phase only. Includes setup and IR construction; NOT a pure kernel measurement.
measurement_contracts.counterexample: Requires an actually returned concrete witness and replay. QCEC exposes no witness through this adapter and is unsupported for this service, while its positive-equivalence decision remains eligible.
measurement_contracts.independent_validation: Independent stage after the service deadline closes: exhaustive scalar gate evaluation up to 10 wires, with its own 2-second wall/2-second CPU budget. Optional symbolic export for validation is not charged to service coverage. Failures retain the computed service checkpoint but never count as oracle-verified success.
measurement_contracts.resources: Linux parent polls RSS/CPU every 10 ms; hard address-space and whole-worker CPU backstops in worker. Service wall/CPU admission starts at ready checkpoint. service_complete checkpoint closes that budget and starts an independent validation wall/CPU budget. Whole-worker wall10s includes imports, both stages and IPC. OS scheduling can add termination latency.
measurement_contracts.worker_cpu: cpu_seconds is the historical worker self-CPU sample before result JSON encoding and process teardown. Future runs additionally report worker_cpu_seconds_reaped: controller RUSAGE_CHILDREN delta before Popen through wait, including encoding and exit cleanup; valid only for the serial controller owning all children reaped during the call. Never retrofit this complete CPU field onto older data.
measurement_contracts.cleanup: The cleanup phase is null because it is not instrumented separately. Process finalization is included only in whole-worker wall and reaped CPU; neither is attributed to service or to an invented exclusive cleanup timer.

backend_configurations.zdd-native-fused: Primary native configuration: actual shipped public zdd-native backend, including its fused C simulation. This is the native denominator for conditional comparisons.
backend_configurations.zdd-native: Secondary explicit matched-loop configuration: NativeZDDAlgebra subclass forces Algebra.simulate in Python. This is not the shipped default and is never pooled with zdd-native-fused.

analysis_plan.conditional_eligibility: Identical case/task/boundary/repetition pairs with both status=ok, positive service times and independently exhaustive oracle_checked=true. No imputation for failures or unrun rows.
analysis_plan.case_estimator: Median of paired peer/native service-time ratios within each case/task/boundary over eligible repetitions.
analysis_plan.family_estimator: Equal-case geometric mean of case median ratios within each family; repetition counts do not reweight cases.
analysis_plan.aggregate_estimator: Equal-family geometric mean of family ratios, reported separately by task and boundary.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Descriptive family-cluster resampling (2000 draws, seed 20261030) and leave-one-family-out sensitivity. Three or four synthetic families do not justify population-level statistical inference.
analysis_plan.coverage: Show all planned/attempted denominators and every timeout, OOM, unsupported, not_run, inconclusive, killed and error, separately from common-solved latency ratios.
analysis_plan.cross_algorithm_agreement: Agreement across symbolic ANF/DD, SAT and/or QCEC algorithm groups is consistency evidence only; it does not set exhaustive oracle_checked or qualify a timing ratio.
analysis_plan.native_modes: Report the primary shipped fused mode and secondary Python-loop native configuration separately. Never select the faster native mode per case.
analysis_plan.calibration_disclosure: The increment generator ignores its seed, so width-matched development tests already constructed the identical increment streams. Both increment cases are development_calibration despite their retained fresh-* IDs. Keep all predeclared cases and the predeclared mixed-study aggregate; do not replace, retune, or discard their results. Report clearly separated holdout-only sensitivity as descriptive evidence, not an independently preregistered primary aggregate.
analysis_plan.classification_erratum: This live classification corrects the original frozen measurement manifest, whose raw new_holdout labels are retained with their exact source and data. The source snapshot and observations must not be rewritten. Fresh affine/shear and adverse randomized cases remain distinct from deterministic increment calibration.
